tools.name: get_public_product_facts
tools.description: Read reviewed public PIO product information with source URLs. Select a topic; no account, team, employee information or private knowledge is accessed. This does not quote customer-specific pricing.

tools.name: estimate_employer_cost
tools.description: Submit an anonymous hypothetical salary scenario to the PIO website calculator. This creates a calculation job, never an employee, bill or payment. Do not use employee records or personal/company information. Explicit country, currency, period and gross/net basis are required. A processing response

tools.name: get_employer_cost_estimate
tools.description: Read the calculation created by estimate_employer_cost using its opaque estimate_id. Keep that handle private. A completed calculation remains an estimate, not a quote or a complete employer cost. Do not resubmit a processing scenario.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcpPublic" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_public_product_facts · Private data: get_public_product_facts, estimate_employer_cost, get_employer_cost_estimate · Public sink: estimate_employer_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_public_product_facts · Private data: get_public_product_facts, estimate_employer_cost, get_employer_cost_estimate · Public sink: estimate_employer_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
